🎥🎬: BEHEMOTH! (2026)
For Alex Serian, music has always been the one constant in a life spent travelling the world. However, after twenty years away, returning to Los Angeles forces him to face the parts of his life he never truly left behind.
As he reconnects with his family and navigates the complicated emotions of coming home, Alex begins to question what matters most. Between his musical ambitions and the relationships waiting to be repaired, he must find a new understanding of who he is and where he belongs.

source_details.synopsis: Behemoth! is a 2026 American drama film written and directed by Tony Gilroy. It stars Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, and Will Arnett. The film premiered at the 64th New York Film Festival on October 2, 2026, and received positive reviews from critics for Pascal's performance, Gilroy's direction, and the musical score but received criticism for its writing and structure. It is scheduled to be released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on December 4, 2026.
